title: Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis.
abstract: Increases in lipid levels and cancers with tofacitinib prompted a trial of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and cancers in patients with rheumatoid arthritis receiving tofacitinib as compared with a tumor necrosis factor (TNF) inhibitor.
journal: The New England journal of medicine
